section_path_text: MMI Daily Iron Ore Index Report June 24 2026
summary:
Main
Today, DCE iron ore futures strengthened in the morning session and dipped slightly in the afternoon today,with the most-traded I2609 contract closing at 744 yuan/mt, up 0.74% from the previous trading session. Port spot prices rose 4-9 yuan/mt from the prior day. Miner activity was moderate, with steel mills primarily purchasing for essential restocking; spot trading volume has been mediocre thus far.
